candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents recurrent bilateral uveitis, which C001 correctly identifies, but the benchmark requires attribution to anastrozole (aromatase inhibitor therapy post-mastectomy) as the causative etiology and includes cystoid macular edema as an integral part of the final diagnostic object. C001 is a parent-level descriptor missing both the drug-specific etiology and the CME component.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures the uveitis component and bilateral/recurrent nature but omits the critical anastrozole-associated etiology and the cystoid macular edema as a required composite component of the benchmark diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Anastrozole-associated uveitis is a rare but recognized adverse effect; the 2.5-year post-mastectomy timeline and anastrozole use are the key etiologic anchors that distinguish this from idiopathic recurrent uveitis.
